name: Add a zone - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Use the Bright Data Account Management API to add a Zone. POST /zone returns 200 OK with zone or account configuration data as JSON.

name: Browser API code examples - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Explore Bright Data Browser API code examples across 3 technologies (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium) for headless browser scraping at scale.

name: skills/skills/bright-data-best-practices/references/browser
snippet: Bright Data Browser API (also called Scraping Browser) is a managed cloud browser service. It handles proxy management, fingerprinting, CAPTCHA solving, and bot detection bypass automatically.

name: Browser API - Automated Browser for Scraping - Bright Data
snippet: The Browser API employ automated unlocking and are opened on Bright Data’s servers, so they are ideal for scaling web data scraping projects without requiring extensive infrastructure.

name: Create your first Browser API - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Get started with Bright Data’s Browser API in just a few steps. This guide walks you through creating your Browser API zone so you can begin running browser-based scraping jobs right away.
